definitions.meaning: Drawing the sword, fighting with the sword

quotations.old_english: Fýnd áteórodun fram sweordtige (mid sweorde, Ps. Vos., Srt.: of sweorde, Ps. Rdr., Spl.) inimici defecerunt frameae

source_text: sweord-tyge, -tige, es; m. Drawing the sword, fighting with the sword :-- Fýnd áteórodun fram sweordtige (mid sweorde, Ps. Vos., Srt.: of sweorde, Ps. Rdr., Spl.) inimici defecerunt frameae, Ps. L. 9, 7.
